mapper.insert: insert into osh_user_book_relation ( user_id, book_id, favorited, followed, purchased, purchase_price, order_no, pay_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, delete_flag ) values ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, 0, 0, 1, #{purchasePrice}, #{orderNo}, now(), #{operator}, now(), #{operator}, now(), null, 0, 0 ) on duplicate key update purchased = 1, purchase_price = values(purchase_price), order_no = values(order_no), pay_time = values(pay_time), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = now(), deleted = 0, delete_flag = 0
